Small visible midriff exactly as in the native practical outfit, no added exposure. Black/dark-brown strappy flat sandals. Preserve native face, skin tone, blouse shape, consistent patterned cloth and jewelry. Do not redesign as a modern outfit, gown, armor, or childlike character.
